text: In this post, we'll explore how combining OpenCClip image embeddings with all MiniLM L12v2 text embeddings can improve photo recommendations.
The article shows how integrating visual and contextual signals with a single, adjustable weight can create an advanced photo recommendation system.
It covers the mathematics of late fusion and offers a step-by-step guide to building the entire pipeline using Node.js and Python,
without the need for a database or vector store.
Visit the full article to learn how to set up your own system.
